First public release of **RaidR** — a computer vision, OCR, and GUI automation research suite for testing graphical interfaces on **Google Play Games on PC**. It interacts purely through visual observation: screen capture and accessibility input simulation. No memory modification, no packet inspection.

## Key Capabilities

- **Visual Scene Recognition & Sequence Orchestration** — automated template matching, perimeter deployment sequence execution, HUD metric telemetry, and dynamic screen recovery.
- **Automated Upgrade Evaluation** — reads building menus with Tesseract OCR heuristics and evaluates resource conditions.
- **Session Telemetry Panel** — real-time HUD reading, free builder detection, storage indicator monitoring, and session metrics.
- **Multi-Profile Support** — profile sequencing and automated state recovery.

## Download

Grab `RaidR.exe` below. Tesseract OCR is bundled inside — there is nothing else to install. `RaidR.exe.sha256` holds the SHA-256 checksum for the build.

## Requirements

Windows 10/11, with target application running in Google Play Games on PC at **16:9** or **16:10**.

## Disclaimer

This project is published solely for educational and research purposes in computer vision, OCR, and humanized GUI input modeling. It is an independent research implementation and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Supercell Oy.
